alynndir_1.m: Hello there. Welcome to my cabin.
r: What do you do around here?
What can you tell me about the surroundings here?

alynndir_10.m: It is home of the best beer in all of Dhayavar! Every year they hold a beer festival. Matter of fact, that event is coming very soon.
r: I think I would like to go there now.

alynndir_16.m: Well, I would too, but it is a very dangerous route to Sullengard. I'd think twice if I were you before making that trip.
r: I sure will. Thanks for the warning.

alynndir_2.m: Mostly, I trade with travelers on the main road on the way to Nor City.
r: Do you have anything to trade?
What can you tell me about the surroundings here?

alynndir_3.m: Oh, there is not much around here. Vilegard to the west, Brightport to the east and Sullengard to the south.

alynndir_4.m: Up north is just forest. But there are some strange things happening there.

alynndir_5.m: I have heard terrible screams coming from the forest to the northwest.

alynndir_6.m: I really wonder what is up there.
r: You mentioned Sullengard. What can you tell me about it?
